calls.thesis: BUY, first tracked for GVI — largest community-portfolio position (16%), up 7%, buying more on dips; adjusted P/E ~11, nearly all FCF funding buybacks of 10%+ of shares a year.

calls.thesis: Still ranked a buying opportunity but conviction CUT to LOW (from medium; was high). DCF fair value $77 vs $55 (~40% upside 12-18mo), forward PE 9.6 — priced as if growth is over. 400M+ accounts, strong FCF, acquisition-target appeal. He SOLD his own PYPL position earlier this year at a loss ($68 avg cost, sold ~$50-55) after third management team in 5 years failed to fix share loss. Growing risk this is a value trap, not a value stock.
calls.base_case: Fair value $77, ~40% upside 12-18 months, possibly sooner via acquisition.
calls.bull_case: Acquired at a premium by a suitor kicking the tires.
calls.bear_case: Value trap: third management team can't re-accelerate growth; competition erodes checkout share.
